transjakarta-brt.label: Transjakarta BRT (Jakpro)
transjakarta-brt.transferRule: Flat fare charged per boarding (tap-in), not per journey: changing vehicle means a new tap-in and a new full fare. A transfer is covered only by the OKOTRIP scheme (max Rp 5,000 within 3 hours, JakLingko co-branded card only) or by the Integrasi Multimodal scheme (max Rp 10,000 within 3 hours, covering Transjakarta BRT + MRT Jakarta + LRT Jakarta). Mikrotrans and non-BRT buses break the multimodal scheme and require a separate ticket. The peak/off-peak band is decided by the tap-in time, not the tap-out time. KLG holders travel free.

microtransFare.note: Mikrotrans JakLingko is free for the passenger as of 2026-10-21: the rider must still tap an e-money card and the operator is paid per distance travelled. DTKJ proposed Rp 2,000 per journey for the 1 January 2027 restructuring; that proposal is not in force.

transjakarta-non-brt.label: Transjakarta non-BRT (Angkutan Pengumpan: Metrotrans, Minitrans)
transjakarta-non-brt.transferRule: Same flat Jakpro fare as the BRT corridors: Rp 3,500 at every time except 05:00-07:00 WIB (Rp 2,000), decided by tap-in time. Each boarding is charged separately; non-BRT buses are excluded from the JakLingko Integrasi Multimodal scheme and BREAK it, so a feeder leg between two covered modes forces a new fare. Royaltrans is a separate non-subsidised product (see royaltransFare) and is never covered by any integration scheme.

royaltransFare.note: Royaltrans (premium bus, 11 routes: S31, 1T, 1K, 6P, D31, D32, B13, B14, S14, S12) is non-subsidised and costs Rp 20,000 flat on every route, with no discount on public holidays. The older 'Rp 20,000-Rp 35,000' range on Wikipedia is the 2018 launch range and is superseded. QRIS Tap (NFC) is accepted on all Royaltrans services since 17 March 2025.

mrt-jakarta.label: MRT Jakarta
mrt-jakarta.offPeakHours: n/a - MRT Jakarta has one tariff all day, there is no time-of-day band

base.note: Fare for the first station hop

perStation.note: Setiap stasiun yang dilalui, di atas tarif dasar untuk stasiun pertama. Lebak Bulus - Bundaran HI (13 stasiun) = Rp 14.000, sesuai tarif maksimum.

mrt-jakarta.transferRule: Progressive fare set on 26 March 2019, effective 1 April 2019: Rp 3,000 minimum, +Rp 1,000 per station passed, maximum Rp 14,000. There is no free transfer to any bus or rail mode; the only way a change of mode is covered is the JakLingko Integrasi Multimodal scheme (max Rp 10,000 in 180 minutes, with a Rp 2,500 boarding fee plus Rp 250/km). A Kartu Multi Trip must hold at least Rp 14,000 to be used on MRT Jakarta. On days the operator declares a celebration the fare can be Rp 1.

lrt-jakarta.label: LRT Jakarta (Jakpro)
lrt-jakarta.offPeakHours: n/a - flat fare, identical at all times
lrt-jakarta.transferRule: Flat Rp 5,000 for one journey, valid for every distance (short or long) on all stations, in force since 1 December 2019. There is no free transfer to Transjakarta, MRT or KRL; a change of mode is only covered by the JakLingko Integrasi Multimodal scheme (max Rp 10,000 in 180 minutes). Single Journey Trip card costs Rp 15,000 (Rp 10,000 card + Rp 5,000 fare) and is not refundable; a paid-area overstay longer than 2 hours without tapping out costs Rp 5,000; the minimum e-money balance is Rp 5,000. LRT Jakarta is not on the Transjakarta Rp 3,500 Jakpro tariff - it has its own flat Rp 5,000 fare.

lrt-jabodebek.label: LRT Jabodebek

offPeak.label: Tarif maksimal di luar jam sibuk

lrt-jabodebek.offPeakHours: 06:00-08:59 dan 16:00-19:59 (Senin-Jumat, di luar libur nasional) = jam sibuk; tarif maksimal Rp 20.000, di luar jam itu serta Sabtu, Minggu dan libur nasional tarif maksimal Rp 10.000

perKm.note: Setiap 1 km berikutnya (same rate at all times of day)

lrt-jabodebek.transferRule: Fare is distance-based and set by Kepmenhub KM 67/2023 as amended by KM 70/2024: Rp 5,000 for the first 1 km, then Rp 700 per further km, capped at Rp 20,000 in the weekday peak (06:00-08:59 and 16:00-19:59) and Rp 10,000 off-peak, on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. The operator also publishes the complete 18x18 station matrix (both the off-peak/SML table and the peak table). There is NO integrated ticket with KRL, Transjakarta, MRT Jakarta or LRT Jakarta: LRT Jabodebek is not one of the three operators in the JakLingko Integrasi Multimodal scheme, so a change of mode costs a second full fare. Payment: KMT, bank e-money (e-Money, Brizzi, TapCash, Flazz, JakCard), JakLingko cards, Access by KAI, LinkAja (QR) and QRIS Tap (all stations since 30 October 2025); minimum card balance Rp 10,000.

krl-jabodetabek.label: KRL Jabodetabek (KAI Commuter)
krl-jabodetabek.offPeakHours: n/a - one distance-based tariff all day, there is no time-of-day band

perKm.note: Equivalent to Rp 1,000 for every further 10 km

max.note: UNKNOWN, not zero: KAI Commuter publishes a formula, not a cap. No maximum was found on any operator or news page read.

krl-jabodetabek.transferRule: Distance-based tariff under Kepmenhub 354/2020 (structure inherited from Permenhub 35/2016): Rp 3,000 for the first 25 km, then Rp 1,000 for every further 10 km. Example: Bogor to Tanah Abang = Rp 3,000 + Rp 1,000 = Rp 4,000. There is no class-based tariff in Jabodetabek any more: all services are KRL AC since the non-AC Economy trains were withdrawn on 25 July 2013, and the single-trip-with-deposit ticket (THB) was abolished on 3 September 2022. The free-out facility was withdrawn on 16 December 2015, so a same-station journey is charged the lowest tariff. JakLingko lets a rider BUY a KRL QR ticket, but the KRL tariff itself is NOT integrated: changing to or from any other mode costs a second full fare, and KRL is explicitly excluded from the Rp 10,000 Integrasi Multimodal scheme. Payment: KMT (minimum balance Rp 5,000), bank e-money, JakLingko, Access by KAI, C-Access, GoTransit QR, QRIS Tap (since 30 October 2025); LinkAja was discontinued on 16 January 2023.

integrations.label: Integrasi Multimodal (JakLingko / PT Jakarta Lingko Indonesia, account-based ticketing)
integrations.includes: Transjakarta BRT (inside BRT haltes only) + MRT Jakarta + LRT Jakarta - three operators. Initial charge Rp 2,500 boarding fee, then Rp 250 per kilometre, capped at Rp 10,000 for the whole integrated journey however long the route. The 180-minute (3 hour) window runs from the FIRST tap-out to the LAST tap-out. Works with Mandiri e-Money, BCA Flazz, BNI TapCash, BRI Brizzi, Bank DKI JakCard and QR tickets bought in the JakLingko transport app. Mikrotrans, non-BRT buses and KRL are NOT included and using one of them between the covered modes breaks the scheme. Past 180 minutes the scheme ends and the last mode is recomputed at its normal fare. Published example: MRT Lebak Bulus - TJ Galunggung - LRT Kelapa Gading costs Rp 22,500 separately versus Rp 9,250 integrated.

boardingAmount.note: Biaya masuk tiket integrasi, dibayar saat tap-in pertama.

integrations.label: OKOTRIP (Transjakarta-only, JakLingko co-branded card)
integrations.includes: Transjakarta BRT and non-BRT (feeder) services only: change buses outside the haltes and pay at most Rp 5,000 within 3 hours. Requires a JakLingko co-branded bank e-money card, which supports the OKOTRIP tariff only and therefore cannot be used for the Integrasi Multimodal tariff.

thenPerKm.note: not applicable - this scheme has no per-kilometre continuation

boardingAmount.note: Tarif maksimal untuk semua perjalanan Transjakarta dalam 3 jam.

integrations.label: JakLingko ABT ticket for KRL (ticketing only, tariff NOT integrated)

price.note: No integrated price - the rider buys a KRL ticket at the normal KRL distance tariff

integrations.includes: A KRL ticket can be bought inside the JakLingko app (ABT QR, Pay-As-You-Go) and a KRL Access QR ticket can be used on Transjakarta, MRT Jakarta, LRT Jakarta and LRT Jabodebek, but KRL is not one of the three operators covered by the Rp 10,000 multimodal scheme and the KRL tariff itself is not integrated: 'penetapan tarif di KRL Commuter Line masih belum terintegrasi dan menggunakan tarif umum yang berlaku saat ini'. A change between KRL and any other mode therefore needs a second full fare.

thenPerKm.note: not applicable - this scheme has no per-kilometre continuation

integrations.label: LRT Jabodebek - no integrated ticket with any other mode

price.note: No integrated ticket exists; each leg is charged at the operator's own tariff

integrations.includes: LRT Jabodebek is not one of the three operators in the JakLingko Integrasi Multimodal scheme. Its 'Rute Integrasi' page advertises physical walking/bridge connections only. Changing between LRT Jabodebek and KRL, Transjakarta, MRT Jakarta or LRT Jakarta requires a separate full fare on each side.

thenPerKm.note: not applicable - this scheme has no per-kilometre continuation

notes: Terminology: for Transjakarta the Rp 3,500 'peak' fare applies at EVERY time of day except 05:00-07:00 WIB, when the Rp 2,000 Layanan Ekonomi fare applies. The band is decided by the tap-in time. So the evening peak (16:00-19:00) is also Rp 3,500.

Announced but not yet in force: on 30 September 2026 the Governor of DKI Jakarta announced that the Transjakarta and Transjabodetabek tariffs, and later the MRT, LRT Jakarta and Mikrotrans tariffs, will be adjusted from 1 January 2027. The new amounts had not been published as of 21 October 2026. The July 2026 proposal is Transjakarta BRT and non-BRT Rp 3,500 -> Rp 5,000, Mikrotrans free -> Rp 2,000, Transjabodetabek -> Rp 10,000. The JSON holds the tariffs that are in force today.
Microtrans is free for the passenger today (operator is paid per distance travelled); the Rp 2,000 figure is a DTKJ proposal, not an adopted tariff.
Royaltrans is non-subsidised at Rp 20,000 flat and is outside every integration scheme. The 'Rp 20,000-Rp 35,000' range still on id.wikipedia is the 2018 launch range.

Minitrans has no published tariff table on any operator site. It is treated as riding the standard Transjakarta non-BRT flat fare (Rp 3,500 / Rp 2,000) by inference from its class; this specific figure is NOT verified from an operator source.

The maximum KRL fare is UNKNOWN: KAI Commuter publishes a formula (Rp 3,000 for the first 25 km, then Rp 1,000 per further 10 km) but no cap. max.amount is 0 as a placeholder meaning 'unknown', not 'free'.

The KRL fare API (api-partner.krl.co.id/krl-webs/v1/fare) and the live commuterline.id site were unreachable (expired JWT / HTTP 503), so the per-station-pair fare table could not be read directly; the operator's published formula was used instead.

Discrepancy: id.wikipedia describes the Integrasi Multimodal scheme as 'tarif awalnya adalah tarif normal moda pertama, serta tarif per kilometer moda berikutnya Rp 250', while JakLingko Indonesia's own FAQ describes the initial charge as a flat Rp 2,500 boarding fee followed by Rp 250/km. The operator's description was used; a planner must not assume the first mode is billed at its own published tariff inside the scheme.
Discrepancy: id.wikipedia states the minimum LRT Jakarta e-money balance is Rp 8,500; the operator FAQ says Rp 5,000. The operator figure was used.

Discrepancy: industry.co.id (9 Oct 2026) restates the KRL fare as 'Rp 3,000 for the first 3 km, +Rp 500 per 3 km' and 'Rp 3,000-Rp 7,000 for a single trip'. That contradicts KAI Commuter's own published rule and was treated as an error in that article.

OKOTRIP (Transjakarta-only, max Rp 5,000 in 3 hours, JakLingko co-branded card) is documented only on id.wikipedia; JakLingko's current 2026 tariff FAQ does not mention it, so it is flagged verified: false and may be superseded by the Integrasi Multimodal scheme.
Free-travel groups: Kartu Layanan Gratis (KLG) holders travel free on Transjakarta, MRT Jakarta and LRT Jakarta. The eligible groups are being widened from 15 to 21.

Transfer tap-in/tap-out rules a rider must respect: Transjakarta charges at tap-out and needs a minimum balance of Rp 5,000; a missed tap-out blocks the card; the KRL free-out was withdrawn in December 2015; the LRT Jakarta paid-area overstay penalty is Rp 5,000 after 2 hours.

Cross-mode connectivity exists without a shared ticket at Dukuh Atas (LRT Jabodebek Dukuh Atas / MRT Jakarta Dukuh Atas / KAI Commuter Sudirman / Transjakarta, via the JPM Dukuh Atas transport hub) and at Manggarai (LRT Jakarta Manggarai / KRL Manggarai). Each side is charged separately.
